entry.title: Notice of Award — NIDA R03DA064666
entry.content:
We are pleased to announce a Notice of Award from the National Institute on Drug Abuse (NIDA).

R03DA064666: Longitudinal Multiparametric Magnetic Resonance Imaging of Outbred Rats with Variable Vulnerability to the Development of Oxycodone Addiction-like Behaviors

This award extends our MRI and whole-brain imaging approach to oxycodone, in collaboration with the NIDA-funded Rat Oxycodone Biobank.
entry.summary: Longitudinal Multiparametric MRI of Outbred Rats with Variable Vulnerability to Oxycodone Addiction-like Behaviors

entry.title: Notice of Award — NIAAA R01AA031958
entry.content:
We are pleased to announce a Notice of Award from the National Institute on Alcoholism and Alcohol Abuse (NIAAA).

R01AA031958: Magnetic Resonance Imaging of Outbred Rats with Variable Vulnerability to Compulsive Alcohol Use

This award will support our work using longitudinal multi-parametric MRI to characterize individual differences in brain features associated with vulnerability and resilience to alcohol use disorder in genetically diverse rats.
entry.summary: Magnetic Resonance Imaging of Outbred Rats with Variable Vulnerability to Compulsive Alcohol Use
